WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT
        HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time / 1000)) AS hour_index,
        DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time / 1000), '%H:00') AS hour_label,
        COUNT(*) AS pay_count
    FROM `event` e
    WHERE e.dt = (
        YEAR(CURDATE()) * 10000
        + MONTH(CURDATE()) * 100
        + DAYOFMONTH(CURDATE())
    )
      AND FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time / 1000) >= CURDATE()
      AND FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time / 1000) < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      AND e.event = 'ServerPayLog'
      AND e.prod = 110000038
    GROUP BY hour_index, hour_label
)
SELECT
    hour_label,
    SUM(pay_count) OVER (
        ORDER BY hour_index
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_pay_count
FROM hourly
ORDER BY hour_index
LIMIT 24;

SELECT

        STR_TO_DATE(CAST(`reg`.`reg_date` AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d'),
        '%Y-%m-%d'
    ) AS `日期`,
    `reg`.`channel` AS `渠道`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `reg`.`uid`) AS `新增用户数`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `act`.`uid`) AS `次日留存用户数`,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT `act`.`uid`)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT `reg`.`uid`), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS `次日留存率`
FROM (
    SELECT
        `e`.`dt` AS `reg_date`,
        `e`.`uid`,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                JSON_UNQUOTE(
                    JSON_EXTRACT(`e`.`adinfo`, '$.mediaSource')
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(
                JSON_UNQUOTE(
                    JSON_EXTRACT(`e`.`adinfo`, '$.campaignName')
                ),
                ''
            ),
            '未知'
        ) AS `channel`,
        CAST(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_ADD(
                    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(`e`.`dt` AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d'),
                    INTERVAL 1 DAY
                ),
                '%Y%m%d'
            ) AS SIGNED
        ) AS `d1_date`
    FROM `event` AS `e`
    WHERE `e`.`dt` BETWEEN
        CAST(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 31 DAY),
                '%Y%m%d'
            ) AS SIGNED
        )
        AND
        CAST(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY),
                '%Y%m%d'
            ) AS SIGNED
        )
      AND `e`.`prod` = 110000038
      AND `e`.`event` = 'UserRegister'
) AS `reg`
LEFT JOIN `event` AS `act`
    ON `act`.`uid` = `reg`.`uid`
   AND `act`.`dt` = `reg`.`d1_date`
   AND `act`.`dt` BETWEEN
        CAST(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY),
                '%Y%m%d'
            ) AS SIGNED
        )
        AND
        CAST(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
                '%Y%m%d'
            ) AS SIGNED
        )
   AND `act`.`prod` = 110000038
   AND `act`.`event` = 'UserActive'
GROUP BY
    `reg`.`reg_date`,
    `reg`.`channel`
ORDER BY
    `reg`.`reg_date`,
    `reg`.`channel`
LIMIT 1000;

WITH
params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS start_date,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS end_date
),
day_offsets AS (
  SELECT 0 AS day_offset UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2
  UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
  UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
),
calendar AS (
  SELECT DATE_ADD(p.start_date, INTERVAL d.day_offset DAY) AS cohort_date
  FROM params p
  CROSS JOIN day_offsets d
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(e.dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS cohort_date,
    e.uid,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.adinfo, '$.mediaSource')), ''),
      NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.adinfo, '$.campaignName')), ''),
      '未知'
    ) AS channel
  FROM `event` e
  WHERE e.prod = 110000038
    AND e.event = 'UserActive'
    AND e.dt BETWEEN
      CAST(DATE_FORMAT(
        DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 14 DAY),
        '%Y%m%d'
      ) AS SIGNED)
      AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(
        DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
        '%Y%m%d'
      ) AS SIGNED)
),
channels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT channel
  FROM cohort
),
date_channels AS (
  SELECT c.cohort_date, ch.channel
  FROM calendar c
  CROSS JOIN channels ch
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(e.dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS active_date,
    e.uid
  FROM `event` e
  WHERE e.prod = 110000038
    AND e.event = 'UserActive'
    AND e.dt BETWEEN
      CAST(DATE_FORMAT(
        DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 13 DAY),
        '%Y%m%d'
      ) AS SIGNED)
      AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(
        DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
        '%Y%m%d'
      ) AS SIGNED)
)
SELECT
  dc.cohort_date AS `日期`,
  dc.channel AS `渠道`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid) AS `活跃用户数`,
  COALESCE(ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a.active_date = DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid), 0) * 100, 2

      AND u.dt BETWEEN

                      INTERVAL '29' DAY
                  ),
                  '%Y%m%d'
              ) AS SIGNED
          )

              DATE_FORMAT(
                  DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY),
                  '%Y%m%d'
              ) AS SIGNED
          )

    STR_TO_DATE(
        CAST(c.cohort_dt AS CHAR),
        '%Y%m%d'
    ) AS `日期`,
    c.channel AS `渠道`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid) AS `账号注册用户数`,
    ROUND(
        SUM(c.pay1),
        2
    ) AS `首日付费金额`,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN d7.dt IS NOT NULL THEN
                    COALESCE(
                        CAST(
                            NULLIF(
                                JSON_UNQUOTE(
                                    JSON_EXTRACT(d7.pay, '$.pay7')
                                ),
                                ''
                            ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)

                        JSON_UNQUOTE(
                            JSON_EXTRACT(latest.pay, '$.paytotal')
                        ),
                        ''
                    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
                ),
                0
            )
        ),
        2
    ) AS `累计付费金额`
FROM cohort AS c
LEFT JOIN `user` AS d7

   AND d7.dt BETWEEN
       CAST(
           DATE_FORMAT(
               DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '24' DAY),

       )

               '%Y%m%d'
           ) AS SIGNED
       )
LEFT JOIN `user` AS latest
    ON latest.uid = c.uid

    c.cohort_dt,

WITH month_card_buyers AS (
    SELECT
        e.uid,
        CASE
            WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.personal, '$.productid')) = '190001' THEN '普通月卡'
            WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.personal, '$.productid')) = '190002' THEN '超级月卡'
            ELSE '其他月卡'
        END AS card_type,
        MIN(e.dt) AS buy_dt
    FROM `event` e
    WHERE e.dt BETWEEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
                  AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
      AND e.prod = 110000038
      AND e.event = 'ServerPayLog'
      AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.personal, '$.productid')) IN ('190001', '190002')
    GROUP BY e.uid, card_type
), active_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        e.uid,
        e.dt
    FROM `event` e
    WHERE e.dt BETWEEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
                  AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
      AND e.prod = 110000038
      AND e.event = 'UserActive'
), retain_days AS (
    SELECT 0 AS retain_day UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
    UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
    UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24
    UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29
    UNION ALL SELECT 30
), series AS (
    SELECT '总体' AS card_type, 1 AS sort_no
    UNION ALL SELECT '普通月卡', 2
    UNION ALL SELECT '超级月卡', 3
), cohorts AS (
    SELECT s.card_type AS series_name, b.uid, b.buy_dt
    FROM series s
    JOIN month_card_buyers b ON s.card_type = '总体' OR s.card_type = b.card_type
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN d.retain_day = 0 THEN '当日' ELSE CONCAT('第', d.retain_day, '日') END AS `留存日`,
    c.series_name AS `礼包类型`,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.retain_day = 0 OR a.uid IS NOT NULL THEN c.uid END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid), 0) * 100, 2) AS `留存率`
FROM cohorts c
JOIN retain_days d ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN active_events a
  ON a.uid = c.uid
 AND a.dt = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(c.buy_dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL d.retain_day DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
JOIN series s ON s.card_type = c.series_name
GROUP BY d.retain_day, c.series_name, s.sort_no
ORDER BY d.retain_day, s.sort_no

    DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d') AS `日期`,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CAST(
                    NULLIF(
                        NULLIF(
                            JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(personal, '$.money')),
                            ''
                        ),
                        'null'
                    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
                )
            ),
            0
        ) / 10000,
        2
    ) AS `充值总额（万）`
FROM event_realtime
WHERE dt = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
  AND prod = 110000038
  AND event = 'ServerPayLog'

WITH registers AS (
    SELECT
        e.dt,
        e.uid,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.adinfo, '$.mediaSource')), ''),
            NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.adinfo, '$.campaignName')), ''),
            '未知'
        ) AS `渠道`
    FROM `event` e
    WHERE e.dt BETWEEN
          CAST(
              DATE_FORMAT(
                  DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 29 DAY),
                  '%Y%m%d'
              ) AS SIGNED
          )
          AND CAST(
              DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d')
              AS SIGNED
          )
      AND e.prod = 110000038
      AND e.event = 'UserRegister'
)
SELECT
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS `日期`,
    `渠道`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS `新增用户数`
FROM registers
GROUP BY dt, `渠道`
ORDER BY dt, `渠道`
LIMIT 300;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT
    e.dt AS cohort_dt,
    CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(e.dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL '1' DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AS d1_dt,
    e.uid
  FROM `event` AS e
  WHERE
    (
      e.prod = 110000038 AND e.event = 'UserRegister'
    )
    AND e.dt BETWEEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY), INTERVAL '28' DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY), INTERVAL '1' DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
), active AS (
  SELECT
    e.dt,
    e.uid
  FROM `event` AS e
  WHERE
    e.dt BETWEEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY), INTERVAL '27' DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED) AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
    AND e.prod = 110000038
    AND e.event = 'UserActive'
  GROUP BY
    e.dt,
    e.uid
), retained AS (
  SELECT
    c.cohort_dt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid) AS d1_retained_users
  FROM cohort AS c
  JOIN active AS a
    ON a.uid = c.uid AND a.dt = c.d1_dt
  GROUP BY
    c.cohort_dt
)
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(CAST(c.cohort_dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS `日期`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid) AS `新增用户数`,
  COALESCE(r.d1_retained_users, 0) AS `次日留存用户数`,
  ROUND(COALESCE(r.d1_retained_users, 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid), 0) * 100, 2) AS `次日留存率`
FROM cohort AS c
LEFT JOIN retained AS r
  ON r.cohort_dt = c.cohort_dt
GROUP BY
  c.cohort_dt,
  r.d1_retained_users
ORDER BY
  c.cohort_dt

WITH
params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(
      DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
      INTERVAL 14 DAY
    ) AS start_date,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS end_date
),
day_offsets AS (
  SELECT 0 AS day_offset
  UNION ALL SELECT 1
  UNION ALL SELECT 2
  UNION ALL SELECT 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 4
  UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6
  UNION ALL SELECT 7
  UNION ALL SELECT 8
  UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11
  UNION ALL SELECT 12
  UNION ALL SELECT 13
  UNION ALL SELECT 14
),
calendar AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(
      p.start_date,
      INTERVAL d.day_offset DAY
    ) AS cohort_date
  FROM params AS p
  CROSS JOIN day_offsets AS d
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(e.dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS cohort_date,
    e.uid,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(
        JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.adinfo, '$.mediaSource')),
        ''
      ),
      NULLIF(
        JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.adinfo, '$.campaignName')),
        ''
      ),
      '未知'
    ) AS channel
  FROM `event` AS e
  CROSS JOIN params AS p
  WHERE e.prod = 110000038
    AND e.event = 'UserRegister'
    AND e.dt BETWEEN
      CAST(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
      AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
),
channels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT channel
  FROM cohort
),
date_channels AS (
  SELECT
    c.cohort_date,
    ch.channel
  FROM calendar AS c
  CROSS JOIN channels AS ch
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    STR_TO_DATE(CAST(e.dt AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS active_date,
    e.uid
  FROM `event` AS e
  CROSS JOIN params AS p
  WHERE e.prod = 110000038
    AND e.event = 'UserActive'
    AND e.dt BETWEEN
      CAST(
        DATE_FORMAT(
          DATE_ADD(p.start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
          '%Y%m%d'
        ) AS SIGNED
      )
      AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%Y%m%d') AS SIGNED)
)
SELECT
  dc.cohort_date AS `日期`,
  dc.channel AS `渠道`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid) AS `用户注册用户数`,
  COALESCE(
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
          WHEN a.active_date =
               DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
          THEN c.uid
        END
      ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid), 0) * 100,
      2
    ),
    0
  ) AS `第1日`,
  COALESCE(
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
          WHEN a.active_date =
               DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 3 DAY)
          THEN c.uid
        END
      ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid), 0) * 100,
      2
    ),
    0
  ) AS `第3日`,
  COALESCE(
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
          WHEN a.active_date =
               DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          THEN c.uid
        END
      ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uid), 0) * 100,
      2
    ),
    0
  ) AS `第7日`
FROM date_channels AS dc
LEFT JOIN cohort AS c
  ON c.cohort_date = dc.cohort_date
 AND c.channel = dc.channel
LEFT JOIN active AS a
  ON a.uid = c.uid
 AND a.active_date IN (
   DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
   DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 3 DAY),
   DATE_ADD(dc.cohort_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
 )
GROUP BY
  dc.cohort_date,
  dc.channel
ORDER BY
  dc.cohort_date ASC,
  dc.channel ASC
LIMIT 3000;
